nodes.label: ClinicalContextAssembler
nodes.description: Centralizes data gathering from upstream services concurrently; adapters are private and use REST only.

nodes.label: GenerationEligibilityPolicy
nodes.description: Single interface for evaluating whether sufficient data quality exists to generate a treatment plan.

nodes.label: BnEvaluationOrchestrator
nodes.description: Orchestrates calls to Bayesian Network models for probabilistic treatment recommendations.

nodes.label: SafetyPolicy
nodes.description: Single interface for deterministic clinical safety checks (e.g., allergies, contraindications).

nodes.label: PrimaryPlanSynthesizer
nodes.description: Pure interface for deterministic, explainable primary plan generation from all inputs and policies.

nodes.label: DdiMedicationChecker
nodes.description: Single interface for Drug-Drug Interaction (DDI) checks on the proposed medication set.

nodes.label: PlanEditLedger
nodes.description: Sole interface for registering and editing plans; implements an append-only, attributable edit log with atomic concurrency control.

nodes.label: PlanFinalizer
nodes.description: Single interface for the multi-step finalization process; re-runs safety checks and creates immutable final plan records.

nodes.label: Repository Pattern (treatment_plan.repository.Repository)
nodes.description: Persistence layer abstraction for the Treatment Plan module; default implementation uses SQLite.

nodes.label: treatment_plan.security.Security
nodes.description: Handles authorization exclusively for the Treatment Plan module, integrating with the central Authentication service.

nodes.label: review-workspace.ts
nodes.description: State management core TypeScript module for the React psychiatrist review UI.

nodes.label: CONTEXT-MAP.md
nodes.description: Normative ownership contract document partitioning entity ownership across INSIGHT modules.

nodes.label: TP-01 Release Gate
nodes.description: Clinical release governance gate; currently BLOCKED pending clinical, regulatory, and privacy stakeholder sign-off.

nodes.label: check_tp01_release_gate.py
nodes.description: Script that intentionally returns BLOCKED until all required clinical stakeholders provide sign-off.

nodes.label: Lifecycle Prototype
nodes.description: Disposable pure-reducer prototype in prototype/ directory for demonstrating the treatment plan lifecycle; not for production.

nodes.label: TP-01-SCOPE-AND-RELEASE-GATES.md
nodes.description: Authoritative governance process document for Treatment Plan scope and release gates.

nodes.label: HANDOFF.md
nodes.description: Handoff document for developers continuing Treatment Plan implementation; describes completed milestones, current state, and next steps.
